answer: Like a subterranean mycelium network, decentralized consensus sustains trust by trading vital nectar among bonded nodes. When a fraudulent identity attempts infiltration, every unverified claim generates an outward ripple across localized peer validations, compounding verification hurdles into a superlinear attacker cost. Much like a fleeting comet burning up before breaching the crust, counterfeit swarms collapse under exponential staking slash curves.
